# settings

**In one sentence:** app-wide settings shared by every project (machine facts, Hugging Face options, defaults for new projects), stored in `~/.prepare_lora_kit/settings.yaml`.

## Why it exists
Things like "where are my models", "which GPU", or "which caption model new projects should
start with" belong to the machine, not to one project. They are edited from the UI's Settings
button. See `docs/settings.md`.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `model.py` | Dataclasses `AppSettings` -> `HuggingFaceSettings` (`home`, `allow_remote_code`), `HardwareSettings` (VRAM tier, CUDA device, SeedVR2 dirs), `ProjectDefaults` (caption/VAE/embedding model ids...). `None` always means "use the app default"; a bad value raises. |
| `store.py` | `load_settings` (cached), `save_settings` / `save_settings_dict` (atomic write), `invalidate`, `apply_environment` (sets `HF_HOME`). Missing or empty file = all defaults; only broken YAML raises. |
| `seeding.py` | `apply_settings_to_pipeline` — copies configured defaults into a **new** project once. Later changes never touch existing projects. |
| `payload.py` | `settings_payload` — everything the Settings modal needs (values, dropdown choices, placeholders). Kept cheap: no GPU probe, no network. |
| `hub.py` | Hugging Face helpers: login/token status, `check_repos` (button-only network calls), `hub_error_context` (turns gated/signed-out errors into actionable messages), `remote_code_allowed` (blocks running a model repo's own Python unless allowed in settings). |

## How it works
- `cli` calls `apply_environment()` before any command, because `huggingface_hub` reads `HF_HOME` once at import. A shell `HF_HOME` wins.
- New project: `project_registry` -> `seeding.apply_settings_to_pipeline` fills e.g. `caption_model_id`, `vram_tier`.
- At run time, `steps/upscale/seedvr2_adapter.py` reads `hardware` (SeedVR2 dirs, CUDA device) as fallbacks.
- The app stores no Hugging Face token; `huggingface_hub.get_token()` finds the one `hf auth login` wrote.

## Who uses it
- `cli/_shared.py`, `project/project_registry.py`, `steps/upscale/seedvr2_adapter.py`
- `hub.py`: `embedding/loaders.py`, `utils/image.py`, `steps/caption_bbox/vlm.py`, `steps/caption_verifier/loader.py`, `steps/vae_gate/vae.py`
- `prepare_lora_kit_ui/bridge.py` — get/save settings, Hub status and repo checks.
- Tests: `tests/settings/`
